preconditions.description: The number of levels n is between 1 and 7000 inclusive.
The number of operations m is between 1 and 7000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= n and 1 <= l <= r <= cnt[t] and 1 <= x <= 10**6 for operation in operations if operation[0] == '1' for t, l, r, x in [map(int, operation.split()[1:])])
preconditions.description: For each type 1 operation, the level t is between 1 and n, the positions l and r are between 1 and cnt[t], and the value x is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= n and 1 <= v <= cnt[t] for operation in operations if operation[0] == '2' for t, v in [map(int, operation.split()[1:])])
preconditions.description: For each type 2 operation, the level t is between 1 and n, and the position v is between 1 and cnt[t] inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result for a type 2 operation is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= 7000 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result for a type 2 operation is between 0 and 7000 inclusive.
